blocks.text: As we have described in seven books the events from the time of the apostles, [^eusebius-church-history-iii-xiii-1] we think it proper in this eighth book to record for the information of posterity a few of the most important occurrences of our own times, which are worthy of permanent record. Our account will begin at this point.

eusebius-church-history-iii-xiii-1.text: Literally, “the succession of the apostles” ( τὴν τῶν ἀποστόλων διαδοχήν ).
